verdict.rationale: Convex documents an official CLI (probe-confirmed at docs.convex.dev/cli/overview) with a broad command set. It covers filesystem-watching dev pushes with type generation, running queries, mutations and actions with --watch, log streaming, import/export, health insights, and local deployments, all of which an agent or AI-native user can drive from a terminal. missing for 10: explicit agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., documented non-interactive/machine-readable output for agents), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
